answers.how: From 1.000 s to 3.000 s, the boat moves about 382 px and the shark 230 px. Boat speed = 3 × 382/230.
The shark moves about 115 px/s, giving a scale of 3/115 m/px. The boat is about 381 px long.
The shark is about 124 px long. Using the motion-derived scale, length = 124 × 3/115.
The shark is about 46 px high, including its fins. Height = 46 × 3/115.
